text:
Rafi Morales: Quick update 1: regulatory flagged for APAC syndication on tomorrow's launch. We must add a short addendum to the press advisory restricting partner syndication to their respective countries.

Sana Iqbal: Clarify: partners can still republish in-country, but no cross-border syndication?

Rafi Morales: Correct. In-country ok. No cross-border pickup until we clear localized compliance review next week.

Lucas Reed: Ugh. That affects three partner outlets we queued for broad syndication. PartnerOps, we need a rapid outreach list and messaging.

PartnerOps: On it. I'll flag affected partners and draft a hold email. Do we pull assets or just add the addendum?

Maggie Chen: Let's add the addendum to the advisory and push an updated press kit link. For partners who already received assets, send the hold email and request deletion of redistributed copies.

LegalBot: Recommended language: "Please note: per regional compliance review, cross-border syndication is temporarily restricted. Republishing within your country remains allowed. We will notify when restrictions lift." Legal approval granted for that copy.

Rafi Morales: Good. Use Legal's wording verbatim. PressOps  push updated advisory and new press kit by EOD.

PressOps Bot: Updated advisory draft uploaded: https://go.redwood/press/advisory-addendum-2026. New press kit URL will be https://assets.redwood/press/launch-v2. PressOps will send updated advisory to media at 17:30 PT. Reminder set.

Lucas Reed: Social question: do we pause paid amplification in regions where partners might syndicate cross-border? We don't want mismatch.

Maggie Chen: Yes pause paid boosts in APAC until we sign off. SocialBot, can you hold APAC-paid campaigns and delay organic posts by 30m to sync with advisory?

SocialBot: APAC paid campaigns paused. Organic post delay of 30m scheduled. Will resume on manual confirm. :white_check_mark:

PartnerOps: Draft hold email ready. Key asks: delete redistributed copies, confirm acceptance of in-country-only republish, and ack receipt. I'll send to partners after Legal stamp.

LegalBot: Partner email template approved. Also advise keeping a log of partner confirmations for audit.

Rafi Morales: SalesOps  please notify partner account leads to expect outreach and to help with compliance questions. Also prepare a partner-facing FAQ snippet.

Lucas Reed: I'll ping SalesOps Slack and include a two-line script for partner leads.

Maggie Chen: PR ops: update media list to include note about regional restriction, and add a column tracking partner confirmation. PressOps Bot can you add that field?

PressOps Bot: Added "partner_confirmed_restrictions" field to list and set reminders for follow-ups in 48 hours.

Rafi Morales: One more: customers may see partner posts; prepare a short support note explaining the restriction and that it does not affect product availability. CSM team to use the FAQ snippet.

PartnerOps: FAQ snippet for CSM drafted: "This is a temporary regional compliance restriction on partner syndication. The product launch and availability are unchanged for all customers. We will notify when syndication restrictions are lifted"

LegalBot: Keep copies of all partner acknowledgments for 12 months in the compliance folder.

Rafi Morales: Timeline recap: (1) Legal-approved addendum inserted into advisory now (2) PressOps pushes updated advisory at 17:30 PT (3) PartnerOps sends hold email immediately after (4) Social pauses APAC paid and delays organic (5) SalesOps + CSM briefed. If no objections by 16:45 PT we proceed.

PressOps Bot: Internal reminder set for 16:45 PT for final go/no-go. Outreach scheduled at 17:30 PT as planned. :white_check_mark:

Maggie Chen: Thanks all. Keeping thread for confirmations. Please post partner acks here when received.
